answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 39937 Country: India Title: Was tahajjud prayer obligatory because it is mentioned in the Quran Question: Was tahajjud prayer obligatory because it is mentioned in the Quran (17:79), if not then let me know that whether it is Sunnah or nafl? Answer ID: 39937 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1074/1074/M=1433) Tahajjud salah is not fardh rather it is nafl, but the holy Prophet Muhammad (صلى الله عليه وسلم) has regularly performed it hence it is right to say it sunnah as well. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
